summary: Comprehensive testing of new contracts features: (1) Looking-Now vs Future timing, (2) simplified Meeting Location (visibility + system + curated major hubs), (3) Medical/Rescue privacy redaction. All backend and frontend behaviours match the spec. Backend 7/7 passed (1 skipped due to pre-existing 'demo user already has active contract' constraint - not a regression). Frontend modal/card/details flows fully verified for both poster (admin) and non-poster (demo) viewers including server-side privacy redaction.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/demo-login returns 200 with token and non-admin user
POST /api/contracts (paid COMBAT, timing=now, public Stanton-Lorville, payment 50000) creates and appears in GET list
POST /api/contracts (future scheduled COMBAT with scheduled_start_at + scheduled_timezone + Pyro-Checkmate) saved correctly
POST /api/contracts (LFG, no payout) returns category=LFG and payment_amount=0
POST /api/contracts (multi-crew COMBAT with manifest [Pilot 50k, Gunner 30k]) returns is_multi_crew=true, status=mustering, payment_amount=80000

PRIVACY (single GET): MEDICAL contract with rescue_exact_location='SECRET_LOC_*' returns full private fields to poster (admin) and null to non-authorized (demo) user; public risk fields (rescue_injury_tier=T2, rescue_pvp_area, rescue_bleedout_minutes) preserved for demo
PRIVACY (list GET): SECRET_LOC_* string absent from demo's /api/contracts list response body; present in admin's response
rescue_bleedout_expires_at is computed server-side from rescue_bleedout_minutes (verified for 1 and 15 minute inputs)
Frontend create modal: data-testid timing-now-btn / timing-future-btn present; selecting Future reveals scheduled-date-input + scheduled-time-input + scheduled-timezone-select

Frontend create modal: meeting-visibility-select + meeting-system-select present; selecting Stanton populates meeting-major-location-select with curated hubs (Area18, Baijini Point, Orison, Seraphim Station, Grim HEX, Lorville, Everus Harbor, New Babbage, Port Tressler) - no long POI list
Frontend create modal: selecting Pyro shows curated Pyro hubs (Checkmate Station, Ruin Station, Pyro Gateway)

Frontend create modal: switching category to MEDICAL hides meeting-major-location-select (single system select only) and shows all 9 medical inputs (rescue-bleedout-input, rescue-tier-select, rescue-pvp-select, rescue-npcs-select, rescue-aa-select, rescue-food-select, rescue-exact-input, rescue-body-input, rescue-notes-input)

Frontend job board cards: rescue-card-summary rendered for MEDICAL contracts, bleedout-countdown live counter present, timing-badge-now / timing-badge-future visible for now and future posts respectively
Frontend cards: SECRET_LOC string NOT present in card HTML even for poster (cards show 'Exact location hidden until accepted')

Frontend ContractDetails (poster/admin): rescue-public-panel + rescue-private-panel + details-bleedout-countdown + details-timing-now all present; SECRET_DETAILS_TEST_777, BODY_DTL_777, NOTES_DTL_777 all visible in private panel
Frontend ContractDetails (non-poster/demo): rescue-public-panel present + 'Exact location hidden until accepted' note visible; rescue-private-panel NOT rendered; SECRET/BODY/NOTES not present in HTML
Bleed-out countdown ticks live in details view (observed 59:55 -> 59:49 within seconds of view)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend redact_private_fields uses early-return when user is poster/admin/accepted - good pattern. It mutates contract dict in-place; if same dict is later reused for another user this could leak, but the GET list rebuilds list per request so no leak in practice.

Demo user 'already has active contract' constraint prevents fully exercising bid->accept->review flow with a fresh demo user; consider either (a) auto-cleanup of stale demo contracts or (b) returning unique demo users per call to enable full end-to-end bid testing in automation. Bid endpoint itself is unchanged from prior iterations and reported working in iteration_11/12.
Frontend Contracts page POST_JOB modal still shows LISTING DURATION select for MEDICAL+now (correct per spec - only timing=future hides it). Spec compliance verified.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 executed; 1 skipped due to environmental demo-user constraint, not a regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all create-modal, card, and contract-details privacy tests passed for both poster and non-poster viewers)

test_credentials.demo: POST /api/auth/demo-login (no body) returns Demo_Player non-admin token

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_* contracts during testing: TEST_paid_combat (now/Stanton-Lorville), TEST_future_job (future/Pyro-Checkmate), TEST_lfg_grouping, TEST_multicrew, TEST_medical_privacy (with secret payload), TEST_medical_short_bleedout, TEST_UI_medical_card, TEST_UI_med_details. None of these need cleanup; they exercise legitimate flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contract details route is /contracts/:id (plural), NOT /contract/:id. Demo login via POST /api/auth/demo-login with empty body. To test from frontend, set localStorage.navcom_token + navcom_user from the demo response then navigate. Region prompt modal blocks UI on every full page load - either click region-skip-btn or set localStorage navcom_onboarding_done='true' (this only skips the carousel, NOT the per-session region prompt, so always handle region-skip-btn). Privacy tests verify both list (/api/contracts) and single (/api/contracts/{id}) GET endpoints redact rescue_exact_location/rescue_body_location/rescue_private_notes. Bleedout countdown is client-side computed from rescue_bleedout_expires_at (server-set).
